_comment: AIgis subscription feed template. Copy, modify and host this file (HTTPS only). Fields starting with underscore are documentation and ignored by the parser, as is any unknown field (forward compatibility).
_name: Display name shown in the AIgis UI (max 64 chars). Always displayed together with your host name.
name: Corporate PII Masking Rules
description: Example feed: enforces masking of internal project codes and server names.
_customWords: Optional. Plain strings are masked literally (case-insensitive, word boundaries). Entries wrapped in /.../ are treated as regex ONLY if the subscriber enables 'Allow Regular Expressions' for this feed; otherwise they are matched as literal text. Regex flags i, m, s and u are respected per pattern; without flags, matching is case-insensitive - write any flag set without i (e.g. /Foo/m) for case-sensitive matching. Max 5000 entries, 256 chars each. Patterns with nested quantifiers like (a+)+ are rejected for ReDoS safety.
_config: Optional. Applied only if the subscriber enables 'Apply Settings' for this feed AND confirms the shown changes. Every key is optional - omit what you don't want to manage. Unknown keys are dropped.

config._settings: enabled: master protection switch (boolean). debugMode: verbose console logging (boolean). usageProfile: 'strict' masks everything, 'developer' skips safe dev values like localhost or example.com (string). peekMode: persistently reveal original values behind badges (boolean). vaultPruneDays: days until unused vault mappings expire, 1-365 (integer).
config._modules: Toggle individual detection modules (all boolean). email, iban, phone, address, url, ip, path (file paths), secret (API keys, tokens, credentials), custom (custom dictionary incl. this feed's words), toon (JSON-to-TOON token optimization).
